book.name: Jon
book.title: JON Kamambuno Wakai Jon muno boglkwa

content: Yomba 5,000 Yesus kaiya mokna tongwa
Yesus ka di kondo okuwo ye Galili Niglmong sipraksi ende koglo imbo ongwa, ana niglmo mong i kangiye ta Taiberias.
Ana yomba merkinde Yesus omara mokomugl eingwa, sraglpre yomba kinde sungwa Yesus erewakai ere tongo, ye diu orkwa kanigwa ikra pre eingwa.
Ana Yesus ende egli kamun muglo ta ongwa. Ana igle yene disaipelma wagle bogl akiye amedi meglkwa.
Ana Juda yomba Pasova ne-ne erikwa engeno i ende magl ungwa.
Enge igle Yesus kangwa yomba merkinde ende ye moglmara wingo, ana ye di Pilip tongwa, “Nono aglomere bret topo ertre ana yomba i tomuno ye prapra neimbi kuno erambe?”
Yesus eremogl Pilip ta eran kanagledi pre yegl dungwa, ba Yesus sragl taragl erambuka i yene nomane mina pango pirkondungwa.
Ana Pilip di ikine endungwa, “Nono ba 8 kongun ere topomo ingwa i ende bret topo oun kade ana yomba prapra ye kuri-kuridi neimbi ta kuno erekrambuka.”
Ye disaipelma wagle suwarata kangiye Andru, ye Saimon Pita angigle, yegl dungwa,
“Yagl gak ta yawagle moglkwa ye bret bali 5 ya te fis kembra suwo yei moglkwa. Ba yomba prapra i neimbi kuno ta erekrambuka.”
Ana Yesus eremogl disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Yomba ditembi kugl merkinde moglmara iro amediyondo.” Ana yomba prapra amedingo, yagl nambano 5,000 mereyegl meglkwa.
Yesus bret ake indre God diwakai yeite, ana yumbusi yomba amedi meglkwa i tongwa. Te ye ombugl fis indre kuno yegl orko, ana yomba prapra ye merkinde ninamnedi pirmere neingo kuno orkwa.
Enge igle yomba prapra neingwa kuno orko, Yesus yegl di disaipelma wagle tongwa, “Ikine tau yoko moglkwa i ene gande makai siyo, nono diurkwa suwarata akesi dinamuniwo.”
Yegl dungo ye bret 5 ikra mina yomba prapra neingwa kuno orko, tau yoko yongwa ya diurkwa gande makai sindre ana basket 12 gre kau singwa.
Ana Yesus kimagl orkwa i yomba kandre yegl dingwa, “Kaima yene, ye propet ta ende makandle unambe dingwa ikra ungwa.”
Ana Yesus pirkan orkwa, yomba undre yombuglo ere Yesus king morambedi eraglkwa mereyegl pango ana i pre ye yene mundu ende ikine kamun muglo ongwa.
Yesus nigl bolamugl konbauna ungwa
Ande beinagledi orko, Yesus disaipelma wagle ende ime niglmong eingwa.
Igle ye bot ta mina ende egli pindre ana niglmong sipraksi ende Kaperneam kamun enapre ende eingwa. Ana kamun mim pai kondungo, ye eimara igle Yesus akiye ta pikrikwa.
Ana kamun ir pond mangungo ana nigl sitombuno yakemake tongwa.
Ana disaipelma wagle bot awaresi pi 5 mo 6 kilomita yegl ta pindre ye kanigwa, Yesus nigl bolamugl konbauna wu bot mina mangigl wora ungo kade, ana ye kundugl geglkwa.
Ba Yesus ditongwa, “Kundugl goglkriyo, i na wingwa.”
Ye gunyei ana Yesus isuna bot mina endongo ana bot onglandi kaima endpi dumo enamunedi pre eimara igle kra plau dungwa.
Yomba eremogl Yesus pre dokingwa
Enge i pradungo tangina yomba nigl koglo ya meglkwa ye kanigwa bot suwarata pai moglkwa, ana bot i mina Yesus disaipelma bogl akiye ta pikrukwa. Ba yene disaipelma keunde ende eingwa.
Ana okuwo bot tau, Tiberias yei ende wu Yesus ye bret diwakai yei tongo yomba neimara igle kra magl wingwa.
Yomba kanigwa Yesus disaipelma bogl igle moglkrikwa, ana ye bot tau wingwa ikra mina ende suna pi, Yesus pre doko ende Kaperneam kamun eingwa.
Yesus yene kor-meglkwa bret
Yomba ende nigl koglo imbo pi ana Yesus moglko kandre, ye krapogl teingwa, “Beke Notnga, ene enge aunake ende igle une?”
Yesus ka mongo di ikine endungwa, “Na ka kaima ene di teinga, ene na pre dokingwa, i ene kimagl kanigwa ikra pre ta manga, ba ene bret neingwa dano orkwa ikra pre erikwa.

Ene kaiya mokna kinde orkwa ipre kongunmo erekraglkwa ba ene kaiya mokna kor aimande moraglkwa ipre kongunmo eriyo. Te kaiya mokna kor-moraglkwa i yene kaneta, Yomba Wam ene tenambuka, taragl i pra erambedi pre ana Nem God yombuglomo te kondungwa.”
Ye krapogl Yesus teingwa, “No srambre ere God kongun eraglmedi prumere i ouno kuno erambe?”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “God kongunmo yegl: God yomba ta diendungo ungwa i ene pirngi dinaglkwa.”
Ipre ye krapogl Yesus teingwa, “Ene sragl kimagl etn no i kandre ana ene pirngi dinamune? Mo ene sragl taragl eratne?
No yagl awano okuna makan waule igle mana neingwa i pepa mina muno yegl beglko pangwa: ‘Heven suna bret-mana i God te atne endungo neingwa.’”
Yesus ditongwa, “Na ka kaima ene diteinga, Moses taragl tongwa i heven bret ta manga, ba na Nina heven suna bret kaima i ene tongwa.
Ana God bret tongwa i ye heven suna ende atne undre, ana makan yomba koglkoglo kor-moraglkwa pre tongwa.”
Ye dingwa, “Yagl kande, bret i engenge no noro.”
Ana Yesus dinongugl endungwa, “Na nana kor-meglkwa bret, yomba ta ende na mina unambuka ye kindan goglkrambuka, te yomba ta na wedi pirngi dinan, ana ye nigl goglkrambuka.
Ana na ene diteinga, ene na kan-kondingwa ba pirngi dikrikwa.
Yomba prapra Nina na narkwa i ye ende na mina unaglmiwo, yomba ta na mina unambuka ana na ye kinde kondokraglka.
Sraglpre na heven suna ende atne winga i nana pirmere eraglka pre manga, ba na diendungo winga yagle prumere mere eraglka.
Na diendungwa yagle i yegl eretenedi prukwa, yomba prapra na nare kondungwa i suwarata na kinde kondokraglka ba enge kande mina ye prapra simangimbo andigl ukor enaglkwa.
Ana Nina yegl prukwa, yomba prapra Wam kandre pirngi ditembi ye kor aimande moraglkwa. Ana enge kande mina na yomba simange ikor endinaglka.”
Enge igle Juda yomba deno kumbro Yesus teingwa, sraglpre Yesus ka yegl dungwa ipre, “Na bret heven suna imbo ende atne winga.”
Ipre ye dingwa, “Yagl i Yesus, ye Josep wam moglkrumo? Te ye nem ya mam nono pirkan ounga. Sragl orko ye erme ka yegl di, na heven ende atne wiye dume?”
Ana Yesus di ikine ende tongwa, “Enene mina deno kumbro di imboriya ende meglkwa i kondiyo.
Yomba ta yene pirmere ende na mina ukraglkwa, ba Nina na diendungwa yagle ye yomba auro iyu na mina endinambuka. Ana na enge kande mina ye simangimbo andigl ukor enambuka.
Ana propet wagle ka dingo pepa muno yegl beglko pangwa, ‘Yomba prapra God yene ka di beke tenambuka.’ Te yomba ta Nina kamo pirtre pir imbi, ana ye ende na mina unaglkwa.
Yomba suwarata Nina kankrikwa ba suwarata God mina ungwa i keme kangwa, God mina mogltre ungwa i keunde ye Nem kangwa.
Na ka kaima ene diteinga, yomba ta pirngi dinambuka ye kor aimande meglkwa inambuka.
Kor meglkwa bret i na nana moglka.
Ene kowano ye makan waule suna bret-mana neingwa ba ye geglkwa.
Ba bret-mana heven imbo ende atne ungwa i yomba ta ninaglkwa, ana ye goglkraglkwa.
Na nana kor-meglkwa bret i heven imbo ende atne wingwa ba yomba ta bret i ninan, ye kor aimande morambuka. Ana bret na tenaglka i na nangina, yomba koglkoglo kor aimande moraglkwa ipre na tenaglka.”
Juda yomba ye deno kumbro tengramodi yegl dingwa, “Yagl i srambre ere ye nangiye noran ana nono ninamne?”
Yesus di yomba tongwa, “Na ka kaima di ene teinga, Yomba Wam nangiye ya ye bormaimo i ene ta nekrimbi ana kor-moraglkwa i ene mina paikrambuka.
Yomba ta na nangina nendre te bormaina neimbi ye kor aimande moraglkwa inaglkwa, te enge kande mina na ye simange ikor endinaglka.
Sraglpre na nangina i kaiya mokna kaima, te na bormaina i nigl kaima.
Yomba ta ye na nangina ya te bormaina ninan ana ye na mina suna moran, ana na ye mina suna moraglka.
Ana Nina kor-moglkwa ye na diendungwa, ana ye mina na ama kor-moglka, mambuno kuno yeglmere, yomba ta na ninambuka ye kor-morambuka, sraglpre na yombrana mina inambuka.
Bret i heven imbo ende atne ungwa. Ene kowano awano ye bret-mana nendre ana okuwo ye geglkwa. Yeglmere ta manga, ba yomba ta bret i ninambuka ye kor aimande morambuka.”
Kaperneam kamun makai yungu yungugl kra Yesus ka bekete mogltre ana ka i ditongwa.
Yesus kamo i mina kor aimande moraglkwa
Disaipelma wagle ya yomba merkinde Yesus kamo pirtre ana yegl dingwa, “Ka giglendi kaima beke norkwa, ka i ira pir-inambe?”
Yomba ta Yesus ka i ditekrikwa, ba Yesus kango ka dungwa ipre tengramo dingwa. Yeglpre Yesus ka di yomba tongwa, “Ka dinga ipre ene yumbun de pirmo?
Ana Yomba Wam ende ikine pi okuna mogl umara enan ana ene kandre sragl wedi piraglme?
Ana yomba kor-meglkwa i God Spiritmo tongwa, ba nangino kongunmo ta paikrukwa, na ka ene erme dite moglka i spirit ya te kor-meglkwa ka.
Ba ene yomba tau pirngi dikrikwa.” I Yesus okuna mambuno bogl umara ime ye kangwa yomba tau ye pirngidi tekrimbi, te iramere ye i-pene ende kunda ikine onguno mina yenambuka i pirkan orkwa.
Yesus ka di aine yegl dungwa, “Ana mambuno ipre na ene diteinga, yomba yene ta na mina ukraglkwa, ba Nina ta akepledi tenambuka yomba i keunde na mina unaglkwa.”
Enge igle Yesus ka dikondungo ana yomba mokomugl eingwa ikra ende ikine pindre ana Yesus omara aglketa pikrikwa.
Yeglpre Yesus krapogl disaipel 12 wagle tongwa, “Ene ama na kondo endinamnedi pirmo?”
Saimon Pita di ikine ende tongwa, “Yaglkande, no ira moglmara enamune? Ana kor aimande meglkwa ka i ene mina pangwa.
Ana no etne pirngi dumga, te pirkan ounga i ene Suwara Holi mogltre, God mina unga.”
Yegl dingo ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ene 12 prapra na ta pinde ikrisino? Ba ene mina suwarata spirit kinde moglkwa.”
Yesus eremogl Judas pre dungwa, ye Saimon Iskariot wam, ana disaipel 12 mina Judas okuwo Yesus i-pene ende kunda ikine tenambuka.
